data.standardized_narrative: The report for Syndicate 3000 in 2020 does not explicitly state a quantified prior year reserve movement. The gross claims development table on page 17 shows no further development for prior underwriting years within the 2020 reporting period, as the "Current estimate" for each prior year is identical to its last reported value. The narrative on page 3 mentions that "The 2019 year was impacted by the higher than expected losses on prior years of account," indicating strengthening for prior years in 2019, but no similar statement or quantification is provided for 2020. The underwriting result for 2020 was a loss of GBP 145.2m, primarily driven by GBP 152.7m in COVID-19 losses and GBP 18.4m from 2020 natural catastrophes (Derecho storms and Hurricane Laura).
raw_causal_phrases: The 2019 year was impacted by the higher than expected losses on prior years of account.
The 2020 year was impacted by GBP 152.7m of COVID-19 losses and GBP 18.4m of natural catastrophe losses on the Derecho storms and hurricane Laura.

COVID-19 impacted the result of the Syndicate with additional gross losses of GBP 201.7m and net of reinsurance GBP 152.7m, adding 32.9 points to the combined ratio. The losses were primarily a result of cancelled events from the enforced lockdown, impacting our Contingency book.
The 2016 year was impacted by natural catastrophe losses on the Alberta wildfires and hurricane Matthew with net losses of GBP 17.9m.

The 2018 year was impacted by natural catastrophe net losses of GBP 22.8m; California Wildfires; hurricane Florence; hurricane Michael.
